اعتقلتا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَقَلَتَا (iʕtaqalatā) /iʕ.ta.qa.la.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِعْتَقَلَ (iʕtaqala)
# اُعْتُقِلَتَا (uʕtuqilatā) /uʕ.tu.qi.la.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِعْتَقَلَ (iʕtaqala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
